visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black hair and thick-rimmed black glasses, wearing a blue and white plaid shirt, is seated at a dark wooden table. She is positioned in the center of the frame against a clean white wall with some architectural lines. She holds a red cylindrical food container with both hands, moving it slightly as she looks directly at the camera. Yellow text overlays appear briefly at the bottom. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the red instant noodle cup held by a hand. The cup is labeled "CUP NOODLE" in large red letters on a white background, and below it, there are Japanese characters and illustrations of small yellow chick characters. A yellow slogan banner with Chinese characters "番茄蛋包飯口味" is superimposed on the lower third of the screen. (3) The woman uses her fingers to peel back the foil lid of the cup. The camera angle shifts to show the interior of the cup, which is packed with small, bright yellow cubes that look like scrambled eggs, completely covering the dry noodles beneath. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the egg bits. (4) A hand enters from the left holding a beige electric kettle, pouring a steady stream of clear hot water into the cup. The water creates small bubbles as it hits the noodles and eggs. The woman’s face is partially visible in the background, looking down at the cup with a focused expression. (5) The woman uses light-colored wooden chopsticks to stir the noodles and egg pieces inside the cup. A close-up shot shows the yellow egg pieces floating in a vibrant orange-red broth. The steam from the hot water is slightly visible rising from the cup. She holds the cup lid partially open with one hand. (6) The woman lifts a bundle of thin, pale noodles with her chopsticks and brings them to her mouth. She sucks the noodles in with a vigorous motion, her eyes squinting slightly behind her glasses as she chews. A variety text overlay "（瘋狂吸入）" appears near her face in the center of the screen. (7) The woman continues eating and talking to the camera, gesturing with her chopsticks and free hand. She maintains eye contact with the lens while describing the food. Her facial expressions vary from neutral to smiling. Several lines of Traditional Chinese subtitles appear sequentially at the bottom of the frame over the dark table.
